description: New electric vehicle charging points is a series of datasets listed in Redes-spain open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a national body, published or maintained by Redes-spain. This dataset contains the number of new public-access electric vehicle charging points added each month, detailed at the municipal level. For these purposes, charging points with an electric vehicle access fee are considered public-access. Coverage: Spain. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Electric Mobility. Its keywords are begasa. The portal shows 26 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-02-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-redes-spain-portal.
